newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: New chief named at Colombia's state oil company.
newsitem.headline: New chief named at Colombia's state oil company.

text.p: Colombian President Ernesto Samper appointed Antonio Urdinola, head of the government's privatization board Fogafin, to take over as president of the state-run oil company Ecopetrol, a statement from the presidential palace said.

It said Urdinola, who has extensive experience in the energy and finance sector, had been named to replace Luis Bernardo Florez, who is leaving Ecopetrol after less than 1-1/2 years on the job to fill a vacancy on the board of directors of Colombia's central bank.
Urdinola will be the third president of Ecopetrol, Colombia's single-largest earner of foreign exchange, since Samper took office in 1994.
